hypotheses.H2: conditional James_B placed all teddy/gnome tableaux
hypotheses.H3: James_A or James_B placed a bounded subset

required_inputs.scene_ledger: JSON array of exact teddy/gnome tableau scenes with canonical location_key and access tags
